comments: Input facts: ego is a car responder, agent1 is a pedestrian initiator, and agentStatic is a car responder; the forward moving ego interacts with a pedestrian in the trafficway moving around, entering, exiting, or interacting with an adjacent vehicle/object. Chosen assumptions: agentStatic is stopped ahead in the same lane. Initiator agent1 walks rearward along its right side and away from its rear toward the approaching ego, remaining in the trafficway instead of traversing the road. The schema crossing maneuver denotes this directed pedestrian movement. Ego brakes on pedestrian proximity, with a separate close-vehicle brake trigger; agentStatic stays stopped. Speeds: ego 4–6 m/s, pedestrian 1.1–1.4 m/s; vehicle separation 16–20 m; pedestrian response threshold 8–10 m. Conflict opportunity, without requiring collision.
